book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: Rau To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Yes Korin Muuŋ 1 Korin—1 Corinthians

content: Krisi imaat ve imundig pa mateeŋ wa
Yam toŋvetaz, you naghaze napei ŋgar tiam muul pa varu poia to navotia payam ve aghami wa. Varu poia tonene, to aazne ayondyood ila.

Varu poia to muuŋ navotia payam, ighaze aghur ila ve akisi tuŋia, nene pale inim ataam payam ve Maaron igham mulin gham. Eemoghon ighaze akisi maau, nene pale inim mbeb sorok, ve aghita ghurla tiam anoŋa maau. Ro 1:16+, 11:22; Hib 3:14
Saveeŋ tiina kat to muuŋ tisavia payou ve anag nasakia ilat payam, nene vene: Krisi, ye igham inaad ve imaat pa sosor toit itaghon Maaron aliŋa to timbooda. Is 53:5+; Ga 1:4; 1Pe 2:24
Ve titavia izila mateeŋa inadi ve mboŋ inim tol, ghoro Maaron ipamundigini pa mateeŋ. Nene paam itaghon Maaron aliŋa to timbooda. Lu 24:46
Sawa to imundig, ye ila ivot to Petrus muuŋ. Ghoro ila ivot to mbaŋooŋa toni tisob ve tighita. Mk 16:14; Lu 24:34+; Yo 20:19
Muri ghoro, ye ila ivot to tamtoghon toni irau 500 ve avua pida, ve tisob tighita. Ndiran tonowen, katindi tinepneep sone. Ve pida timaat wa.
Ghoro ivot to Yakobus
ve ighita. Ghoro ila ivot to mbaŋooŋa toni tisob. Mbaŋ 1:3+

Yes mbaŋooŋa toni tisob tighita ve inim inim le muri ghoro, ivot tiou ve anag naghita paam, ve isob. Onoon, ataam to ye igham ghou nanim mbaŋooŋa toni, nene ite pa ataam to ye igham mbaŋooŋa toni pida. You nanim tamtoghon to tina ipoopa ila sawa toni kat maau.
Mbaŋ 9:3+; 1Kor 9:1

Mbaŋooŋa tisob to Krisi izadi ilib payou. Onoon, you mbaŋooŋa toni paam. Eemoghon naghita taug naghaze you poiag irau to tiwaat ghou tighaze mbaŋooŋa to Krisi maau. Pasa, muuŋ, naghur pataŋani naol pa lupuuŋ to Maaron. Mbaŋ 8:3; Ga 1:13; 1Tim 1:13

Eemoghon poia to Maaron itoor ghou, tauto nanim mbaŋooŋa to Krisi ve aazne nataghon ŋgar toni. Poia toni iza tiou sorok maau. Ighur anoŋa. Pasa, you nagham katin uraat le nalib pa mbaŋooŋa tisob. Eemoghon you taug maau. Poia to Maaron ineep tiou, tauto ipapalot ghou ve naghamgham uraat tonene. 2Kor 11:5,23, 12:11+; Kol 1:29
Tovenen ighaze you, ma mbaŋooŋa pida nivotia varu poia pa tamtoghon, nene yei nisob nisasavia saveeŋ tovene pa mateeŋ ve mundigiiŋ to Yesu Krisi. Ve saveeŋ tonene, tauto yam alooŋa ve aghur ila.
Maaron pale ipamundigin yes mateeŋa
Yei nivovotia saveeŋ pa tamtoghon tovene: “Maaron ipamundigin Krisi pa mateeŋ wa.” Ighaze venen, pughu vena to tiam pida tighaze Maaron irau ipamundigin yes mateeŋa maau? Mbaŋ 2:32+, 4:33, 5:30+
Aghita. Ighaze saveeŋ todi onoon, ve mateeŋa irau timundig maau, nene Krisi paam, Maaron ipamundigini pa mateeŋ maau.
Ve ighaze Maaron ipamundigin Krisi pa mateeŋ maau, saveeŋ to yei nivovotia, nene saveeŋ sorok. Le anoŋa maau. Ve ghurla tiam paam, mbeb sorok.

Ve mbeb ite. Ighaze Krisi imundig pa mateeŋ maau, nene yei tonene nigham kaarom payam pa Maaron iza. Pasa, nipariaaŋ tamtoghon pa tighur ila tighaze Maaron ipamundigin Krisi pa mateeŋ. Eemoghon ighaze saveeŋ tiam tonanan onoon, ve mateeŋa irau timundig maau, nene Krisi paam, Maaron ipamundigini pa mateeŋ maau.
Nayol aliŋag muul. Ighaze saveeŋ tiam onoon, ve mateeŋa irau timundig maau, nene Krisi paam, Maaron ipamundigini pa mateeŋ maau.
Ve ighaze Maaron ipamundigin Krisi pa mateeŋ maau, ghurla tiam, nene mbeb sorok. Le anoŋa maau. Ve sosor tiam inepneep sone.
Ve yes to tighur ila to Krisi ve timaat, yes paam tilaledi wa.

Iit taghurghur mataad pa mundigiiŋ to yes mateeŋa ve nepooŋ poia to pale Krisi igham pait. Eemoghon ighaze saveeŋ to nepooŋ tonowen, onoon maau, ve taghurghur mataad pani sorok, nene takaria tauud wa. Pasa, sawa to taneep izi taan, iit tambaad pataŋani naol. Tovenen tamtoghon avaat lolodi isamin ghiit ilib pa tamtoghon tisob to taan to tineep sami ne.
Eemoghon maau! Maaron ipamundigin Krisi pa mateeŋ wa. Ye inimale aniiŋ mata to imatu ila uum muuŋ. Pasa, ye to imuuŋ pa mateeŋa tisob to pale timundig. Mbaŋ 26:23; Kol 1:18; 1Pe 1:3; Syg 1:5
Aghita. Muuŋ, ŋgeu eez to inim ataam pa mateeŋ ivot. Mundigiiŋ to yes mateeŋa tovene paam. Ŋgeu eez to inim ataam pani ve ivot. Nene Krisi. Mbnp 3:1-19; Yo 11:25; Ro 5:12+

Iit tamtoghon to tavot ila to Adam, tasob taneep ila sosor toni lolo. Tauto iit tasob tamatmaat. Ve yes to tinim Krisi le ve tineep tuŋia ila toni, tovene paam. Muri, Maaron pale ipamundigin di tisob, ve tineep matadi iyaryaar.
Eemoghon tamtoghon tisob pale titaghon sawa todi todi. Krisi to imundig pa mateeŋ muuŋ. Ve tala tala le sawa to ighaze ye imuul inim, ghoro tamtoghon toni tisob anadi timundig. 1Tes 4:15+

Mbeb tonowen isob, ghoro taan sawa ivot, ve ye pale ipasob yes pooza, ve daba tisob to izadi tintina, toman mbeb tisob to tapiridi tintina, le tisob tilaledi. Ghoro ipul uraat to ghamuuŋ pooz imuul ila Tama Maaron nima.
Pasa, Krisi pale igham pooz itaghon Maaron ŋgar toni le irau itatan koia ve tapiridi isob kat, ve ivazag di ila aghe samba. Mbo 110:1; Mt 22:44; Hib 1:13
Ve koia to pale ipasobi muri kat, nene mateeŋ. Syg 20:14, 21:4

Maaron aliŋa to timbooda, isaav ighaze: “Maaron ighur mbeb tisob tineep ila ye samba wa.” Onoon, saveeŋ tonene isaav ighaze mbeb tisob tineep ila Krisi samba. Eemoghon Maaron, ye ineep ila Krisi samba maau. Pasa, ye to ighur mbeb tineep ila Krisi samba. Mbo 8:6; Mt 28:18; Hib 2:8; 1Pe 3:22
Muri, sawa to mbeb tisob tineep deŋiadi ila Natu samba, Natu pale ighur tau ila Tama Maaron samba. Leso Maaron inim daba pa mbeb tisob, ve iŋgin di.
Laak, naghaze naghason gham. Ighaze mateeŋa irau timundig maau, pughu vena to yam pida aghaze agham mateeŋa tiam inadi, ve tigham ya payam? Agham ŋgar tonanan pasa? Pale iuul di vena?
Ve pughu vena to sawa isob, yei nimbadbaad pataŋani pa Krisi iza, ve nireirei taumai pa ndaab. Ro 8:36; 2Kor 11:26

Yam toŋvetaz, yam agham ghou lolog poia. Pasa, uraat tiou ighur anoŋa ivot ila lolomim ve anim Tiina toit Yesu Krisi le wa. Ila ye mata, you nasaav ghazooŋa payam naghaze: Mateeŋ iŋaŋarua ghou irau sawa isob. 2Kor 4:10+

Ighaze you nataghon ŋgar to tamtoghon moghon pa uraat to naghamghami ne, pughu vena to narei taug, ve yeiŋa mbeb sagsagŋa niparab izi ndug Epesus? You naghaze nagham sa kat, to nambaad pataŋani tonowen? Ighaze mateeŋa irau timundig maau, tambaŋa. “Taghanghan, taghunghun, ve takaal leed nepooŋ poia izi taan. Pasa, bozo ma mboŋru, ghoro tamatmaat.” Mbaŋ 19:23+; 2Kor 1:8
Yam apatum gham. Apul tamtoghon titombaan gham malep!

content.text: “Pasa, ighaze iit to tataghon ŋgar poia ne, talup toman ndiran samsamiadi, nene pale tiyes ghiit pa ŋgar todi, ve ŋgar toit isami paam.”

content: Ŋgar tiam iwaghamgham iraua! Agham ŋgar pooi, ve apul ŋgar samia ineeple, ve ataghon ŋgar to deŋia ila Maaron mata. You nasaav ghazooŋa payam: Mayamim. Pasa, yam pida awatag Maaron rita maau.
Anoŋaad papaghu pale ariaŋadi, ve irau tisami maau
Yo. Ŋgeu eta pale ighason ghou tovene: “Ighaze Maaron ipamundigin yes mateeŋa, pale ipamundigin di vena? Ve sawa to timundig, pale igham ledi anoŋadi papaghu to ghitooŋadi vena?”
Yom borou! Lem ŋgar maau! Ughita. Ighaze tavazog mbeb eta uve, nene pale uli imbuuz ve ilale, ghoro paghu toni itub iza. Yo 12:24
Ve ighaze tavazog wit, ma mbeb ite paam uve, nene pale paghu toni to muri itub iza ne, ghitooŋa raraate inimale uuv to tavazogi ne maau. Pale ghitooŋa ite.
Ve Maaron igham mbeb to tavazog di ne titub tiza, ghoro eŋaeŋa tighur ayadi, bogadi, rauadi, ruŋgudi, ve anoŋadi itaghon ye tau ŋgar toni.
Mbeb to tineep izi taan ne, mindadi raratedi maau. Iit tamtoghon mindaad ite, ŋgai todi ite, man todi ite, ve iigh tovene paam, mindadi ite.
Ve mbeb to tineep ila sambam paroŋania ne, anoŋadi ite. Ve mbeb to taan, anoŋadi ite. Mbeb to sambam paroŋania paghunadi, ve mbeb to taan paghunadi paam. Eemoghon yes raratedi maau.
Ndag ŋguruba, nene ite pa kaiyo ŋguruba. Ve pitum tovene paam. Ŋgurubadi ite pa ndag ve kaiyo ŋgurubadi. Ve pitum tisob raratedi maau. Pitum eŋaeŋa ŋgurubadi ite ite.

Mundigiiŋ to yes mateeŋa, nene ŋgara raraate. Ighaze tamaat ve titavia ghiit, nene anoŋaad izila taan ve imbuuz ve ilale. Eemoghon sawa to Maaron ipamundigin ghiit pa mateeŋ, ye pale igham leed anoŋaad papaghu. Anoŋaad papaghu tonenen pale ariaŋadi, ve irau tisami maau.

Anoŋaad to titavia izila taan, nene ghitooŋa poia kat maau. Eemoghon muri, sawa to Maaron ipamundigin ghiit pa mateeŋ, ye pale igham leed anoŋaad to popoia kat, ve ŋgurubadi tiina. Anoŋaad to titavia izila taan, ye le tapiri maau. Eemoghon sawa to Maaron ipamundigin ghiit pa mateeŋ, ye pale igham leed anoŋaad papaghu to tapiridi tintina. Mt 13:43; Pil 3:20+; Kol 3:4
Anoŋaad to titavia izila taan, nene mbeb to taan. Eemoghon sawa to Maaron ipamundigin ghiit pa mateeŋ, ila Maaron Avuvu tapiri, iit pale tagham leed anoŋaad to sambam.
Maaron aliŋa to timbooda, isaav ighaze:

content.text: “Adam, ŋgeu to Maaron ighuri muuŋ, imundig inim tamtoghon, ve mata iyaryaar.” Mbnp 2:7

content: Ve Adam ite to ivot muri,
ye avuvu to igham ghiit taneep mataad iyaryaar le alok. Yo 5:21,24; Ro 5:15+
Tovenen ŋgeu to sambam imuuŋ maau. Ŋgeu to taan toman taan nepooŋa to imuuŋ. Ghoro ŋgeu to sambam inim toman nepooŋ paghu to Maaron Avuvu.
Adam to ivot muuŋ, Maaron igharaata pa taan. Tovenen ye tamtoghon to taan. Ve Adam ite to inim ru pani, ye ineep sambam ve izi inim. Mbnp 3:19; Yo 3:13,31

Tamtoghon tisob to taan, anoŋadi ve nepooŋadi, nene tinimale ŋgeu to taan to Maaron ighuri. Ve yes to pale tineep izi ndug sambam, anoŋadi papaghu ve nepooŋadi, nene tinimale Ŋgeu to ineep sambam ve izi inim.
Aazne, nepooŋ toit, taneep tanimale ŋgeu to taan to Maaron ighuri. Ve muri tovene paam. Nepooŋ toit pale inimale nepooŋ to Ŋgeu to ineep sambam ve izi inim. Ro 8:29+; 1Yo 3:2

Yam toŋvetaz, you nasaav payam tovene: Anoŋaad to taan, nene irau igham nepooŋ to ndug sambam maau. Pasa, mbeb to ndug sambam irau tisami maau. Tovenen mbeb to isamsami inimale anoŋaad to taan, nene irau igham nepooŋ to ndug tonowen maau. Maaron igham leed anoŋaad papaghu, ghoro iit irau tagham nepooŋ tonowen. Yo 3:5+
Maaron igham ghiit talib pa mateeŋ

Alooŋ. You naghaze napaghazoŋan gham pa mbeb eez to muuŋ iyooŋ ve aazne Maaron isavia ivot ighazooŋ. Tamtoghon toit pida pale timaat maau. Pasa, sawa to Mboŋ Muri, Maaron pale itoor ghiit tasob, ve tagham anoŋaad papaghu.

Tavuur to Maaron ighuri pa itaŋ muri kat, pale itaŋ, ve rikia moghon Maaron ipamundigin yes mateeŋa, ve igham ledi anoŋadi papaghu to irau tisami maau. Ghoro iit to tamaat sone ve tanepneep ne, anaad Maaron pale itoor ghiit, ve igham leed anoŋaad papaghu. Mt 24:31; Pil 3:21; 1Tes 4:15+

Pasa, anoŋaad to taan to tisami ve timatmaat, Maaron irau itoor di. Leso tinim paghu, ve irau tisami, ma timaat muul maau. Mbeb tonene ighaze ivot, nene pale Maaron aliŋa waaro eez to timbooda, anoŋa ivot. Isaav ighaze: “Maaron iparab ariaŋa, tauto ilib pa mateeŋ tapiri ve ipasobi le isob kat.” Is 25:8

content.text: “Mateeŋ, tapirim to ulib payei ineep sine?
O mateeŋ, iiz tiom to uŋgal ghei pani ne, ineep sine? Maau.” Hos 13:14

content: Pasa, iiz to mateeŋ, nene ŋgar samia. Ve ŋgar samia ighamgham tapiri ila tutuuŋ. Mbnp 3:3; Ro 4:15, 5:12+, 7:9+
Eemoghon iit tapait Maaron toman lolood poia! Pasa, ila uraat to Tiina toit Yesu Krisi, Maaron igham ghiit talib pa ŋgar samia ve mateeŋ. Ro 8:37; 2Kor 2:14; 1Yo 5:4+

Tovenen yam toŋvetaz to lolog payam kat, you nasaav payam: Ayoon ariaŋa, akis ghurla tiam tuŋia, ve apul taumim kat pa uraat to Tiina toit irau sawa isob. Pasa, yam awatag: Ighaze ye ineep toman gham pa uraat tiam, yam arab taumim sorok pa uraat maau. Uraat tiam pale ighur anoŋa. Ga 6:8; Hib 6:10; Syg 14:13

footnotes.text: Sawa to Yesu inepneep izi taan, mbaŋooŋa toni pida tilaghlaagh tomani. Tovenen tighita uraat toni ve mateeŋ toni paam. Ve sawa tonenen, Yesu ighur di tinim mbaŋooŋa toni. Eemoghon Paulus, ye ilaagh toman di maau. Yesu imuul iza ila pa sambam, ve muri ghoro, ivot to Paulus ve ighuri inim mbaŋooŋa toni.

Adam ite to ivot muri, nene Krisi. Ves 47 iwaata ighaze: “Adam ite to inim ru pani.” Saveeŋ tonene, ŋgara tovene. Adam to ivot muuŋ, iit tasob tavot ila toni. Ye pughu toit. Tovenen sawa to ye igham sosor, iit taneep ila sosor tonowen lolo paam. Krisi tovene paam. Ye inim pughu pa lupuuŋ paghu, nene tamtoghon toni. Yes to tinim Krisi le, tineep ila mateeŋ ve mundigiiŋ toni lolo.
